_format.is_recipe: true if content is a recipe, false if not, 'uncertain' if hard to tell
_format.has_ingredients: true if ingredients should be extractable from the text
_format.has_instructions: true if instructions should be extractable from the text
_format.portions: expected portion count if detectable, null otherwise
_format.notes: optional notes about the test case
